details:
Hi there!

Quick heads-up: I have attempted to switch between beta and stable releases, reinstalled the game, not clearing registry keys during this process. Ran file verification through steam, tried restarting my System. Let me know if you need screenshots or videos of this occurring, will happily submit some, may take me a couple minutes to edit and send these over though.

    **Description**

I can't fully verify if this issue happens in all worlds. The recent beta version had this issue, I switched to live, where this bug now exists a couple days later.

When I join a Terrors of Nowhere instance, the player joins in with their Avatar set to maximum height, this used to occasionally happen, but not break things like it does now.

Currently, the player is set to maximum height on *every* join attempt, resulting in both items and the HUD being oversized if the avatar is set to a shorter height.

The world has not been updated in close to 2 months, so this would probably not be the issue here.

    **Steps to reproduce**

- Open VRChat

- Join or Create an instance of Terrors of Nowhere

- Check player height through the radial menu, should be at 1.70m (world max)

- Enter the lobby and observe the size of the HUD on the lower left hand size of the screen

- Change the player height, keeping an eye on the scale of the HUD

*Optional:*

- Play a round and try to survive to get the `[SP]` counter below the HUD to increase to 1

- Navigate to the item shop on the left side of the lobby, seen from the entrance

- Buy a Burger from the Survival Shop

- Repeat scaling the avatar, keeping a close eye on the held item

    **Expected outcome**

The (*optional*) Item and especially the HUD should keep their same relative size in the player's viewport, as the player scales up or down

    **Actual result**

The HUD and Item increase their relative size in the player's viewport by a great amount, leading to the game becoming unplayable, as this blocks the player's viewport

    **Operating System**

Windows 10 Pro 22H2 Build: 19045.5131

(Also verified to happen on Windows 11 24H2 Build: 26100.2454)
title: Item Sizing Issues
